headerDisplay:
Exposes a HomeKit switch for each qBittorrent server, toggling that server's **alternative speed limits**.

You need the qBittorrent Web UI enabled (*Tools → Options → Web UI*) on every server you add.
footerDisplay: Having trouble? Check the [README](https://github.com/RauchenwaldC/homebridge-qbittorrent-plugin?tab=readme-ov-file#qbittorrent-homebridge-plugin) or open an [issue](https://github.com/RauchenwaldC/homebridge-qbittorrent-plugin/issues).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the switch in the Home app. Give each server a different name.

apiUrl.title: Web UI URL
apiUrl.description: The address of the qBittorrent Web UI, including the port.

username.title: Username
username.description: Leave empty if this server does not require authentication.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave empty if this server does not require authentication.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often, in seconds, to check each server so the Home app picks up changes made in qBittorrent itself.

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout
requestTimeout.description: How long, in seconds, to wait for a server to respond before giving up.
